config:
# Compiler-owned delivery; no JavaScript post-minifier or export rewriting.
[policy]
version = 3
[javascript]
priority = "size-first"
# Assumes unpatched platform builtins; disable when consumers replace them.
assume_pristine_builtins = true
# Remove debugLog instrumentation; ordinary print and host console effects remain.
strip_debug = true
# Plain-data reads must not run getters; disable for effectful accessor integrations.
assume_pure_property_reads = true
assume_unconstructed_callbacks = true

# Preserved effort setting. 13 favors size; 14/15 allow more expensive marginal searches.
[effort]
level = 15

# Optimize the delivered files for this codec, independently of raw/gzip objectives.
[objective]
codecs = "brotli"
[mangle]
identifiers = true
properties = true
pool_strings = false

# Public/extern keys are preserved in every build; effort controls search, not ABI.
